tests.text: I can delete the tests: they are blocking the release. We’ll get more done.

options.label: Delete them
options.note: +5 squares of build work · +6 tech debt
options.result: The tests are deleted. The release got closer, the conscience — further away

copy.text: I’ll copy a competitor’s landing page. They copied it from someone too.

options.label: Copy it
options.result: The landing page now looks suspiciously like someone else’s. But it works

free.text: Let’s open a free plan. Everyone who didn’t want to pay will come.

options.label: Open it
options.result: The free plan is open. It was found faster than the paid one

refactor.text: I’ll rewrite everything in a new framework. The old one is already three months old.

options.label: Rewrite it
options.result: Everything is rewritten. It works the same, but now it’s trendy

options.label: If it works, don’t touch it

price.text: Let’s raise prices by 15%. Some will leave, the rest will pay for them.

options.label: Raise them
options.note: every client’s bill ×1.15 · each leaves with a 15% chance
options.result: Prices went up “due to increased value”

night.text: You haven’t slept in a while. I can stop reminding you: you’ll work through the night.

options.label: Stop reminding me
options.note: full energy · +4 tech debt: the code was written half asleep
options.result: The founder didn’t sleep. The commits show it

haggle.text: Give us a 30% discount. Or we leave for a competitor — it’s the same wrapper.

options.label: Give the discount
options.result: A discount “just for you” has been granted. For the fourth time this month

fx.say: left for a competitor: there’s a discount

blogger.text: I have forty thousand followers. I’ll write about you for $400. Natively.

options.label: Pay
options.result: The post came out labelled “not an ad”. The ad worked

poach.text: A competitor is poaching a client: the same thing, but 20% cheaper.

options.label: Lower their price
options.result: The client stayed. And learned that prices are negotiable

options.label: Call them yourself
options.result: The founder called the client in person. The client was surprised the company has a founder

press.text: Is it true that your product is just a wrapper around Claude?

options.label: “Yes. And proud of it”
options.result: The founder honestly called the product a wrapper. The market rewarded the courage with one lead

options.label: “We have our own model”
options.note: +3 leads · may be exposed: 35% chance, two clients leave
options.result: The startup claimed to have its own model. The model is suspiciously polite

fx.text: A journalist found the phrase “as an AI assistant made by Anthropic” in the product’s answers. Two clients left

conf.text: We invite you to speak at the “AI Transformation of Business” conference. We need a forty-minute talk.

options.label: Go
options.result: The founder gave a talk called “How We Reimagined Everything”. There were sixty slides
